During the [[Tionese War]], a group of [[Warship/Legends|warships]] affiliated with the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]] carried out an '''attack''' on the astronomical object [[Uthtara]], in the process damaging the<ref name="TEGtW" /> [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|hyperspace jump-beacon]] located there.<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref>
